title: Venapce operation manifest
description: operation.json — the package descriptor of a Venapce operation: a bundle of one or more FloMorphic workflows that together carry out one mission for an organization's Stage → Findings → Issues pipeline (a sweep that originates rows, the triage that advances them, a sync that reports them), together with everything the estate must provide for those workflows to run (osctrl, FloMorphic plugins, settings profiles, other operations). One folder = one operation, and every package ships a README that explains the mission as a whole and the part each flow plays. A catalog repository holds one folder per operation.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor completion.

schema.description: Manifest format version. Bumped only when this document's shape changes.

id.description: Stable slug. Unique within a catalog; an install is keyed by <catalog>/<id>.

version.description: Semver. An import of the same id with a higher version is an upgrade.

description.description: One paragraph: what the operation finds out and where it writes it.

readme.description: Path (relative to the manifest) of the package's documentation. REQUIRED to exist: the import refuses a package without it. It explains the mission of the whole operation and — one section per flow, in step order — what each flow does, what it reads, what it writes and what to check afterwards. Rendered on the operation page.

tags.description: Free classification (linux, web, exposure, compliance …). Rows the flows write usually carry a subset of these.

flowTags.description: Labels stamped on EVERY flow this package installs into FloMorphic. They are what the Run-flow picker filters by, so an operator applying a flow to a row sees this operation's handful instead of every flow on a shared canvas. Distinct from `tags`, which classify the package itself for a catalog. Omit them and the install uses `operation:<id>`, so a package is always filterable; the operator can always clear the filter and see every flow.

scale.description: Which kind of estate the operation is meant for — a catalog filter, not a gate. `network` = routers / switches reached through a probe node; `vps` = a handful of servers; `fleet` = hundreds of enrolled endpoints.

min.description: Lowest Venapce version the operation was verified on.

params.description: Operator-set values that adapt the package to one organization (osctrl tags, environment name, thresholds, an allow-list). Flow files reference a param as `${param.<name>}`: a string value that is exactly the placeholder is replaced by the param's value with its own type (so an array param can stand in for a `tags` list), and a placeholder inside a longer string is interpolated as text. Substitution happens at install time; the whole param set is also handed to every run as `$.input.params`.

flows.description: The FloMorphic workflows in the package (FloMorphic workflow export files, `flomorphic.kind = workflow`). A multi-step mission lists several: give each its `step` so the page presents them in order.

key.description: Package-local handle for the flow (the install links this key to a FloMorphic flow id).

file.description: Path of the workflow export, relative to the manifest.

title.description: Overrides the export's own title when set.

role.description: `entry` — an originating run: starts from an empty context (plus params) and produces rows; the Run button on the operation page. `on-row` — runs against one pipeline row (the Run-flow picker on a Stage/Finding/Issue; reads $.row, writes $.outcome). `helper` — called by other flows, never started by hand.

step.description: Position of the flow in the mission (1 = first). Flows sharing a step run independently of each other; a flow without a step is shown after the numbered ones.

doc.description: Path (relative to the manifest) of a Markdown file documenting this one flow in depth — topology, the nodes to review after import, what it writes. Shown inline under the flow on the operation page. The README still carries the flow's summary.

subject.description: For `on-row` flows: which pipeline levels the flow accepts.

schedule.description: Suggested cron expression for an `entry` flow (5 fields, UTC). Advisory — the operator confirms it at install.

writes.description: Pipeline tables the flow writes to.

tags.description: Labels for this one flow, on top of the package's `flowTags` — for narrowing inside an operation that ships several kinds of flow (a stage sweep and a finding review, say). Normalized like every tag: lower-cased, de-duplicated, no commas.

requires.description: What must be up before the flows can run. Every entry is shown as a readiness check on the operation page, with a link to where it is fixed.

targets.description: What must be enrolled for the operation to see anything.

note.description: Shown next to the check (e.g. which tags the sweeps select).

plugins.description: FloMorphic plugins the flows call, keyed by action method names (the portable id across installs — a plugin id is per-install). `venapce` itself is implied by any `db.*` / `osquery.*` action and may be omitted.

repo.description: Git remote to install the plugin from.

settings.description: FloMorphic Node Settings profiles the operator must pick after install (the export never carries one).

for.description: Which node(s) need it, by title or ref.

operations.description: Other operations that must be installed first (their `id`, optionally with a semver range: `id@>=1.2`).

datasets.description: Superset datasets the operation's dashboards read (registered under Visualizations → Datasets).

provides.description: What the operation leaves behind, so the panel can point at it.

tags.description: Tags the written rows carry — the panel offers a saved Issues view per operation from these.

dashboards.description: Native Venapce dashboard definitions (charts + layout) bundled with the package.
